# Sawtooth Industrial Systems (SIS Controls)

> Build-to-print industrial control panels (UL 508A partner network), rapid PLC and VFD component sourcing, and custom skid automation in Boise, Idaho.

Sawtooth Industrial Systems LLC supports industrial manufacturers, municipal water/wastewater facilities, food processing plants, and data center cooling integrators across the Intermountain West with 24-48 hour RFQ turnarounds and 100% FAT-verified control assemblies.

## Core Engineering Information
- Brand: Sawtooth Industrial Systems (SIS Controls)
- Legal Entity: Sawtooth Industrial Systems LLC (Minority-Owned Business Enterprise)
- Website: https://siscontrols.com
- Location: Boise, ID 83713
- RFQ & Sourcing Desk: https://siscontrols.com/rfq/ | rfq@siscontrols.com
- Standards: Built to UL 508A, NFPA 70 (NEC), and NFPA 79 Standards
